## Evaluation

### Forme de l'évaluation

*Contrôle continu noté reposant sur : Continuous graded assessment
based on:*

1. Individual assignment — 30%<br>*Devoir individuel — 30 %*
2. Discussion session 1 — 20%<br>*Séance de discussion 1 — 20 %*
3. Discussion session 2 — 20%<br>*Séance de discussion 2 — 20 %*
4. Quiz (individual) — 30%<br>*Quiz (individuel) — 30 %*

::: {.notes}
~1 min. Both languages given in full since this is graded/binding
information - students should be able to check it in whichever
language they're more comfortable with.
:::
